tool_input.content:
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.worksheet.formula import ArrayFormula

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Summary']

# Data sheet: Student Number in B, Student Name in C, Performance in D
# Lowest performing = D='Lowest Performing'
# We need the i-th lowest performing student for i=1..16

for i in range(1, 17):
    row = 2 + i  # Summary row 3..17
    # Array formula: INDEX(Data!$B$2:$B$66, SMALL(IF(Data!$D$2:$D$66="Lowest Performing", ROW(Data!$D$2:$D$66)-ROW(Data!$D$2)+1), i))
    # B column = student number, C column = student name
    b_formula = '=INDEX(Data!$B$2:$B$66,SMALL(IF(Data!$D$2:$D$66="Lowest Performing",ROW(Data!$D$2:$D$66)-ROW(Data!$D$2)+1),{0}))'.format(i)
    c_formula = '=INDEX(Data!$C$2:$C$66,SMALL(IF(Data!$D$2:$D$66="Lowest Performing",ROW(Data!$D$2:$D$66)-ROW(Data!$D$2)+1),{0}))'.format(i)
    ws.cell(row, 2).value = ArrayFormula('B{0}'.format(row), b_formula)
    ws.cell(row, 3).value = ArrayFormula('C{0}'.format(row), c_formula)

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
